What is a Japan Travel eSIM?

A Japan travel eSIM is a digital SIM that allows you to access mobile data in Japan without inserting or swapping a physical SIM card.

Instead of buying a physical SIM after you arrive or using your home network for data roaming, you can buy your Japan eSIM online, install it before you travel and connect to mobile data when you arrive.

easySim Japan plans are data-only, allowing you to use internet-based services such as:

  • WhatsApp
  • FaceTime
  • iMessage
  • Google Maps
  • Email
  • Social media
  • Video streaming

Your primary SIM can remain available for calls and SMS while easySim provides your mobile data connection. Check your home network’s roaming charges before leaving your primary SIM active abroad.

Japan bundles connect to the KDDI network, with 4G and 5G available. Network availability and speeds can vary by location, device and local conditions.

Whether you’re visiting Tokyo, Kyoto, Osaka or travelling elsewhere in Japan, a prepaid Japan eSIM gives you a simple way to stay connected without changing your physical SIM.

Stay connected in Japan without swapping your physical SIM or relying on data roaming from your home network. An easySim Japan eSIM gives travellers prepaid mobile data that can be purchased online and installed before departure.

Choose a fixed data bundle to suit the length of your trip and expected usage. If you need more data while travelling, you can add another Japan bundle to your existing easySim without installing a new eSIM.

easySim Japan plans are data-only, so you can use apps such as WhatsApp, FaceTime, iMessage and Google Maps over mobile data while keeping your primary SIM available for calls and SMS if required - please check your network provider’s roaming charges if you intend to use your primary SIM for calls and SMS

Japan eSIM Network Coverage

easySim Japan data bundles use the  KDDI network with 4G and 5G speeds available. 

Coverage and speeds can vary depending on your location, device and local network conditions. 

Once you arrive in Japan, make sure your easySim is selected for Mobile Data and Data Roaming is switched on for the easySim line.

How to Activate Your Japan eSIM

Install your Japan eSIM before travelling while you have a reliable internet connection. Installing the eSIM does not start your Japan data bundle before you reach the destination.

When you arrive in Japan, turn on your easySim line, enable Data Roaming for the eSIM and select easySim for Mobile Data in your phone settings.

Your device must support eSIM technology and must not be locked to another mobile network. You can check compatibility before purchasing and follow the dedicated easySim installation guide for your device.

If you keep your primary SIM active for calls or SMS, check your home provider’s roaming charges. If you do not need your primary line while travelling, switching it off can help avoid unexpected roaming fees.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is an eSIM for Japan?

A Japan eSIM is a digital SIM that lets you use mobile data in Japan without inserting a physical SIM card. With easySim, you can buy a prepaid data bundle online, install the eSIM before your trip and connect when you arrive.

When should I install my Japan eSIM?

Install your eSIM before travelling, ideally while you have a reliable Wi-Fi connection. Your Japan data bundle will not start simply because you install the eSIM before your trip; it becomes usable when you reach Japan and connect to a supported network. See our eSIM Installation Guides for setup instructions.

How do I activate my eSIM when I arrive in Japan?

Turn on your easySim line, enable Data Roaming for the eSIM and select easySim for Mobile Data in your phone settings. Your device can then connect to a supported network in Japan.

Which network does easySim use in Japan?

easySim Japan bundles currently use KDDI with 4G and 5G available, although coverage and speeds vary by location, device and local network conditions.

Does a Japan eSIM come with a phone number for calls and SMS?

easySim Japan eSIMs are data-only and do not include a Japanese phone number, traditional voice calls or SMS. You can use internet-based services such as WhatsApp, FaceTime and iMessage over your easySim data connection. Your primary SIM can remain available for normal calls and SMS if your device supports dual SIM, but check your home provider’s roaming charges.

Can I use my Japan eSIM as a hotspot?

Yes. You can use your easySim data connection for personal hotspot or tethering on compatible devices, allowing you to share mobile data with another device. See our eSIM hotspot guide for more information.

Can I keep my primary SIM active while using an eSIM in Japan?

Yes, on compatible dual-SIM devices. Select easySim for mobile data and keep your primary SIM available for calls or SMS if needed. Check your home network’s roaming charges before leaving the primary line active abroad.

Do I need to turn on Data Roaming for my Japan eSIM

Yes. Data Roaming must be enabled for your easySim line when using your Japan data bundle. Make sure easySim is also selected as the SIM for mobile data.

Can I buy an eSIM for Japan online before I travel?

Yes. You can buy an easySim Japan eSIM online before departure, install it on a compatible unlocked device and use your mobile data when you arrive in Japan. This means you do not need to find and swap to a physical SIM after landing.

How much eSIM data do I need for Japan?

The amount of data you need depends on the length of your trip and how you use your phone. Messaging and light browsing use less data, while maps, social media, video calls and streaming use more. Choose from the available fixed-data Japan bundles and add another bundle if you need more data.

What should I do if my eSIM is not working in Japan?

First check that your easySim line is switched on, easySim is selected for Mobile Data, and Data Roaming is enabled for the easySim line. Put your phone on Airplane Mode for 20 seconds, then switch it off and allow the eSIM to reconnect. If the issue continues, use the eSIM Not Working Guide or contact support.

What is a Japan Travel eSIM?
A Japan travel eSIM is a digital SIM that allows you to access mobile data in Japan without inserting or swapping a physical SIM card.
Instead of buying a physical SIM after you arrive or using your home network for data roaming, you can buy your Japan eSIM online, install it before you travel and connect to mobile data when you arrive.
easySim Japan plans are
data-only
, allowing you to use internet-based services such as:
WhatsApp
FaceTime
iMessage
Google Maps
Email
Social media
Video streaming
Your primary SIM can remain available for calls and SMS while easySim provides your mobile data connection. Check your home network’s roaming charges before leaving your primary SIM active abroad.
Japan bundles connect to the KDDI network, with 4G and 5G available. Network availability and speeds can vary by location, device and local conditions.
Whether you’re visiting Tokyo, Kyoto, Osaka or travelling elsewhere in Japan, a prepaid Japan eSIM gives you a simple way to stay connected without changing your physical SIM.

Why Choose easySim for Japan Travel
Stay connected in Japan without swapping your physical SIM or relying on data roaming from your home network. An easySim Japan eSIM gives travellers prepaid mobile data that can be purchased online and installed before departure.
Choose a fixed data bundle to suit the length of your trip and expected usage. If you need more data while travelling, you can add another Japan bundle to your existing easySim without installing a new eSIM.
easySim Japan plans are data-only, so you can use apps such as WhatsApp, FaceTime, iMessage and Google Maps over mobile data while keeping your primary SIM available for calls and SMS if required - please check your network provider’s roaming charges if you intend to use your primary SIM for calls and SMS
Japan eSIM Network Coverage
easySim Japan data bundles use the KDDI network with 4G and 5G speeds available.
Coverage and speeds can vary depending on your location, device and local network conditions.
Once you arrive in Japan, make sure your easySim is selected for Mobile Data and Data Roaming is switched on for the easySim line.
How to Activate Your Japan eSIM
Install your Japan eSIM before travelling while you have a reliable internet connection. Installing the eSIM does not start your Japan data bundle before you reach the destination.
When you arrive in Japan, turn on your easySim line, enable Data Roaming for the eSIM and select easySim for Mobile Data in your phone settings.
Your device must support eSIM technology and must not be locked to another mobile network. You can check compatibility before purchasing and follow the dedicated easySim installation guide for your device.
If you keep your primary SIM active for calls or SMS, check your home provider’s roaming charges. If you do not need your primary line while travelling, switching it off can help avoid unexpected roaming fees.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is an eSIM for Japan?
A Japan eSIM is a digital SIM that lets you use mobile data in Japan without inserting a physical SIM card. With easySim, you can buy a prepaid data bundle online, install the eSIM before your trip and connect when you arrive.
When should I install my Japan eSIM?
Install your eSIM before travelling, ideally while you have a reliable Wi-Fi connection. Your Japan data bundle will not start simply because you install the eSIM before your trip; it becomes usable when you reach Japan and connect to a supported network. See our
eSIM Installation Guides
for setup instructions.
How do I activate my eSIM when I arrive in Japan?
Turn on your easySim line, enable Data Roaming for the eSIM and select easySim for Mobile Data in your phone settings. Your device can then connect to a supported network in Japan.
Which network does easySim use in Japan?
easySim Japan bundles currently use KDDI with 4G and 5G available, although coverage and speeds vary by location, device and local network conditions.
Does a Japan eSIM come with a phone number for calls and SMS?
easySim Japan eSIMs are
data-only
and do not include a Japanese phone number, traditional voice calls or SMS. You can use internet-based services such as WhatsApp, FaceTime and iMessage over your easySim data connection. Your primary SIM can remain available for normal calls and SMS if your device supports dual SIM, but check your home provider’s roaming charges.
Can I use my Japan eSIM as a hotspot?
Yes. You can use your easySim data connection for personal hotspot or tethering on compatible devices, allowing you to share mobile data with another device. See our
eSIM hotspot guide
for more information.
Can I keep my primary SIM active while using an eSIM in Japan?
Yes, on compatible dual-SIM devices. Select easySim for mobile data and keep your primary SIM available for calls or SMS if needed. Check your home network’s roaming charges before leaving the primary line active abroad.
Do I need to turn on Data Roaming for my Japan eSIM
Yes. Data Roaming must be enabled for your easySim line when using your Japan data bundle. Make sure easySim is also selected as the SIM for mobile data.
Can I buy an eSIM for Japan online before I travel?
Yes. You can buy an easySim Japan eSIM online before departure, install it on a compatible unlocked device and use your mobile data when you arrive in Japan. This means you do not need to find and swap to a physical SIM after landing.
How much eSIM data do I need for Japan?
The amount of data you need depends on the length of your trip and how you use your phone. Messaging and light browsing use less data, while maps, social media, video calls and streaming use more. Choose from the available fixed-data Japan bundles and add another bundle if you need more data.
What should I do if my eSIM is not working in Japan?
First check that your easySim line is switched on, easySim is selected for Mobile Data, and Data Roaming is enabled for the easySim line. Put your phone on Airplane Mode for 20 seconds, then switch it off and allow the eSIM to reconnect. If the issue continues, use the
eSIM Not Working Guide
or contact support.
